issue: v2 logic oscillated: side-obstacle detection caused unnecessary turns when front was clear (needs_revision flag)
likely_cause: Old v2 logic turned away from side-blocked directions even when front was clear, causing wasteful oscillations. Also, when goal direction was blocked, v2 turned AWAY from the goal (e.g. goal on left + left blocked -> RIGHT), requiring a second correction turn back toward goal.
recommendation: Apply v3 revision: never turn on side-only detections (keep FORWARD while front clear); when goal direction is blocked and front is clear, keep FORWARD rather than detouring away; when front IS blocked, prefer turning toward goal-side direction.
